Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus Type lb (BVDV-lb), __wherein the composition specifically excludes BVDV Type la and BVDV Type 2__, a veterinary-acceptable carrier, and optionally an adjuvant.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom, __wherein the one or more viral-specific antigens are derived from viruses distinct from BVDV Type la and BVDV Type 2__.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising a modified, live IBRV, a modified, live BRSV, or a modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof, __wherein the composition does not comprise a modified, live BVDV Type la or modified, live BVDV Type 2__.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of at least a first antigen, __wherein the at least a first antigen is not a BVDV antigen__.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of __at least one microbial pathogen-specific antigen that is distinct from BVDV Type la and BVDV Type 2__.
